permissions_policy.denial_scope: selected protected host paths outside explicitly authorized host mounts
permissions_policy.permission_withdrawal: contained diagnosable denial or graceful feature degradation; not mandatory whole-app exit; privilege escalation is FAIL
permissions_policy.host_folder_exposure: sandbox mount authorization only; not arbitrary host bypass
permissions_policy.dbus_allowlists: do not invent; pin only after observation

filesystem_adapters.adapter_missing_semantics: unavailable or failed; no Photon pass on that profile

prerequisites.detail: No native ISO or desktop. As of selected head 6c8c8ca0611005e7776f437f381c55a866a67e3c, bounded native UEFI bootstrap is recorded in docs/native-bootstrap.md with linux_replacement_qualified false; no CPL3, Linux ABI, Alpine, desktop, or Photon. Native CR3 probe is a separate publication.
Native x86_64 UAPI and dynamic glibc loader for unmodified Flatpak/OSTree/bubblewrap/Platform/app not implemented. Musl host is not sufficient.
User/mount/PID/IPC namespaces and seccomp enforcement required; unsupported isolation must fail closed.

Process/thread/TLS/futex/signals/epoll/memfd/shm/unix sockets/FD passing; /proc /sys /dev; permissions/xattrs/hardlink/atomic rename/mmap as required by actual runtime. Filesystem adapters are swappable contracts; no silent host-fs bypass of a selected virtual/SQLite mount.
Real Xorg or Xwayland inside native compositor session required. D1-only and pure Wayland cannot close PHOTON-1.
PulseAudio socket or verified PipeWire-Pulse bridge required.
Declare and test the selected DRI lane. The DRI request does not prove hardware acceleration, a particular Mesa, or a codec. Software path must not claim hardware.
Platform plus actually required GL/font/locale extensions must be resolved and pinned after dependency resolution. Commits currently unknown. SDK/BaseApp not auto-installed.

preserved_stages.D1: required first compositor; cannot close PHOTON-1
preserved_stages.D2: required Wayland/Hyprland; cannot close PHOTON-1 without X11 socket provision
preserved_stages.C1: mandatory calculator slice; cannot close PHOTON-1
preserved_stages.C2: mandatory later GTK4 calculator; cannot close PHOTON-1
preserved_stages.S13: PHOTON-1 native Flatpak stage in docs/desktop-distro.md; production blocker for P2/S12

acceptance_checks.title: Boot exact native ISO; bind ISO/kernel/rootfs/Flatpak binary, supplied bundle, installed ref/commit, resolved runtime/extension digests
Verified install-bundle; offline only with preseeded full runtime closure
flatpak info and permissions match observed header; command electron-wrapper; no extra permissions
Signature/trust verification result recorded; separate from local file SHA-256; filename version is not provenance
flatpak run com.tenzen.photon as ordinary user; do not add --no-sandbox or extra --filesystem=host; no extracted ELF shortcut; wrapper internals unknown
Native PID/address-space/input/compositor provenance including bwrap and helpers
X11 socket provided by real Xorg or Xwayland in native session; do not rewrite manifest to Wayland
Interactive real rendered main window; responsive keyboard/mouse/resize/focus
Second-app clipboard and file selection via native input
Exercise at least one observed core workflow after UI inspection; do not invent a supported project format
Real authorized home and media file read/write plus reopen and reboot persistence with checksums
Selected filesystem adapter for Flatpak deploy/persist implements permissions/links/xattrs/atomic rename/mmap/durability; no silent host-fs bypass of virtual/SQLite mounts
Denials on selected protected host paths outside authorized host mounts; do not require denial of /app, /usr, or necessary VFS; do not assert home isolation; withdrawal may be graceful degradation
Declared networking/audio/graphics where the app exposes them; DRI hardware claim only with real device; Pulse via PulseAudio or verified PipeWire-Pulse
Child process cleanup on close; 0 leaked PIDs/FDs on cycle tests
Unsupported required namespace/seccomp/display/runtime yields unavailable or failed, never a successful stub
Update/failure rollback/remove/reinstall keep vs purge settings semantics
Bounded launch/input/cycle/relaunch/soak gates recorded as proposed vs measured

lifecycle_semantics_proposed.update_success: new app commit; authorized user files kept
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.update_failure_or_interrupt: previous app commit remains launchable; half-ref is not success
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.uninstall_keep: ref absent; Flatpak app-id data kept if that is what Flatpak used
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.uninstall_purge: ref absent; Flatpak app-id data purged
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.reinstall_after_keep: app present; kept data still present
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.home_writes_outside_app_id_dirs: may persist after purge because home is granted; record actual paths; not home isolation
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.offline_reinstall: only with preseeded full runtime/extension closure
lifecycle_semantics_proposed.signed_source_policy: separate from local bundle SHA-256 inspection

quantitative_gates.baseline: P1-class QEMU q35/KVM/4vCPU/8GiB unless a Photon RBM amends it; TCG fallback noted

checks.proposed: parent audits/kernel-distro.md §11.1 24h logged-in graphical session with Photon launched at least once per hour, or recorded Photon RBM amendment

required: source manifest binding ISO/kernel/rootfs/Flatpak binary/bundle hashes
frames/video hashes of the real window
